validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a"><transition event="go" target="f" target="a"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

notes: each attribute may appear at most once in a start tag; a parser cannot choose between two values
diagnostics.help: keep one `target` attribute; a transition to several states lists their IDs in one value, separated by spaces (`target="a b"`)
spec_references: XML 1.0 (Fifth Edition) §3.1 Start-Tags (WFC: Unique Att Spec)
